product_summary: Subros Limited (subros.com) is India's largest automotive thermal-solutions manufacturer since 1985, with 8 plants (Noida compressor & die-casting & heat-exchanger plants, Manesar, Karsanpura, Chennai, Pune, Nalagarh). Real product lines per own site: (1) Compressors — swash-plate fixed-displacement models 10SL08/10SL09/10S11/10SA13/10S13/10SL15 (80–157 cc) and rotary-vane SV07/SVE08 (70/84 cc) for auto HVAC; (2) HVAC units for passenger vehicles, buses, trucks, off-highway, rail driver-cabin AC kits; (3) Condensers — Multi-Flow and Integrated Receiver Drier condensers, 11.5/12/16/26 mm thickness, incl. for home ACs; (4) Evaporators (Multi-Flow); (5) Heaters (lightweight aluminium); (6) Tubes & hoses, IHX assemblies (aluminium tubes, rubber hoses); (7) Radiators; (8) Bus AC kits, Rail AC kits; (9) Transport Refrigeration Systems; (10) Residential & commercial cooling — split AC IDU+ODU 1.0–2.0 TR (R32/R410A), light-commercial and ductable AC 5.5–17.0 TR, reciprocating compressors.
comment: HS 841430 (compressors for refrigerating equipment) is CORRECT for the compressor line and is the company's core declared code — partial match only, because the site shows a much wider thermal-systems portfolio that the single declared code does not cover: condensers/evaporators/heat exchangers (8415 90 / 8418 99 / 8419 50), complete vehicle AC units and kits (8415 20), radiators (8708 91), aluminium tubes and rubber hoses (7608/4009), and residential/commercial split & ductable ACs (8415 10 / 8415 82). Industry claimed as 'IT и электроника' is a clear MISCLASSIFICATION — Subros is an automotive thermal/air-conditioning components manufacturer (IATF-16949, ISO 14001 certified), not IT/electronics; industry field should be corrected to automotive components / HVAC. No trader signs: own plants, own tool room, in-house die casting, Denso collaboration — genuine manufacturer. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company retained, code set to 841430 as primary with the additional codes above. All product data is from the company's own website pages (subros.com/products/compressors/, /condensers/, /residential-commercial-cooling-solution/) — no customs line was checked in this task, so shipment-level corroboration of any specific HS line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue, export volumes, PAN/CIN not researched per role scope — null.
